description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach. It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with vector store, OpenAI API, and custom utilities to facilitate question-answering based on textbook chapters.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs a retrieval-augmented generation process: embedding the question, searching relevant text chunks, constructing a prompt, and calling the OpenAI API to generate an answer.
